summary: Backend testing complete for Roblox Artist Monitor Discord bot. All 8 pytest cases pass (3 HTTP endpoint tests + 4 Roblox/audio pipeline tests + 1 Mongo index/uniqueness test). HTTP endpoints return correct shapes, bot is ready with user populated and guilds>=1, RobloxClient successfully searches Kevin MacLeod audios, fetches details/thumbnail, downloads >100KB OGG, and audio_processor produces a non-empty waveform PNG + valid float LUFS/LRA/TruePeak. MongoDB unique indexes confirmed on (guild_id,artist_key) and (guild_id,artist_key,asset_id), and duplicate insert correctly raises DuplicateKeyError.
critical_code_review_comments: bot.py:180 _write_tmp fallback when processed is None could leave no OGG attachment if processed_audio_bytes returned None - acceptable but worth a log.

roblox_client.download_audio doesn't validate Content-Type or signature; a 200 HTML error page from CDN would be returned as 'audio'. Low risk since assetdelivery is stable, but adding a magic-bytes check (OggS header) before posting would harden the pipeline.
audio_processor.process_audio_bytes runs ffmpeg twice on the same file in parallel; fine but consider single-pass via -filter_complex split for CPU savings at 1000+ artists.

scan_artist marks asset as processed even if process_and_post returned False (bot.py:236-238); a transient ffmpeg/download failure permanently silences that audio. Consider only mark_processed on ok=True.
Slash command sync runs both globally and per-guild on every on_ready; harmless but produces duplicate command registrations during startup loops.
test_credentials: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN already configured in /app/backend/.env; no other credentials needed.
seed_data_creation: Test inserts/cleans one TEST_GUILD_pytest monitor row to verify DuplicateKeyError; cleaned up in finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend functions verified end-to-end against live Roblox toolbox-service and Discord gateway. Tests run with pytest --asyncio-mode=auto. Kevin MacLeod first-page audio IDs were used for live pipeline test; switch to another artist if Roblox de-publishes those. The bot.add_monitor upsert path was indirectly verified through the unique-index test (raw insert -> DuplicateKeyError; add_monitor's existence check then update_one is the bypass).
